items.question: What percentage of total UAE electricity generation in 2025 came from clean energy, including nuclear power and renewables?
items.gold: 32.4 per cent of total electricity generation.
items.fact: UAE clean energy share of 2025 electricity generation was 32.4%

items.question: How much does the UAE government aim to invest by 2031 to meet growing energy demand under its energy strategy?
items.fact: UAE government plans up to AED 200 billion investment by 2031
